business_problem: Southern Cross Health Insurance was running IT service management on decades-old applications and infrastructure, leaving teams siloed and limiting visibility into services and assets.
solution_summary: Southern Cross Health Insurance was running IT service management on decades-old applications and infrastructure, leaving teams siloed and limiting visibility into services and assets. Southern Cross Health Insurance implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, and CMDB. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; IT Operations Management extends visibility into infrastructure and operations; CMDB stores service and asset context. Requests enter through Virtual Agent and Employee Center, and uses context from CMDB before ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and IT Operations Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: IT Operations Management
solution_components.role: Extends service visibility into infrastructure and operations for proactive management.

solution_components.name: CMDB
solution_components.role: Maintains service and asset context that automation and support teams rely on.

solution_components.name: Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Handles conversational self-service and ticket deflection for users.

solution_components.name: Employee Center
solution_components.role: Serves a single portal for requests, knowledge, and support interactions.

data_flow: Requests enter through Virtual Agent and Employee Center, and uses context from CMDB before ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and IT Operations Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Southern Cross raised user satisfaction to 99.3%, improved service-level resolution by 36%, and strengthened visibility and collaboration by consolidating IT management on one platform.
architecture_clues: CMDB quality is treated as a prerequisite for automation, service context, or visibility.
evidence_quotes: Since 2019, Southern Cross has been using ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) to increase visibility into its entire IT infrastructure
However, with decades-old applications and infrastructure, its approach to IT service management was siloed, limiting collaboration between teams
Its initial focus was on incident and change management, but with multiple tools used by different IT teams, collaborating and resolving issues became difficult
Its team worked with Southern Cross to identify key challenges and build a roadmap on how the could better adopt ServiceNow and maximize its return on investment
To that end, the health insurer has adopted ServiceNow Impact , the industry’s first human and AI-powered value acceleration solution to track progress and business outcomes
